summary: The PR addresses the issue of exiting when pressing Enter in the root path prompt during sphinx-quickstart with an existing conf.py file. However, it introduces a minor inconsistency in the exit code.

issues.description: The PR changes the exit code from 1 to 0 when exiting. Typically, an exit code of 0 indicates success, while non-zero codes indicate errors. This might be confusing for users or scripts relying on the current behavior.
